24003.commentary: (MNa) gaggarā'ti laddhavohārā pokkharaṇī atthi. tassā tīre samantato nīl'ādi-pañca-vaṇṇa-kusuma-paṭimaṇḍitaṃ mahantaṃ campakavanaṃ. tasmiṃ bhagavā kusumagandhasugandhe campakavane viharati. taṃ sandhāya gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā campāyaṃ viharati gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi.

divāvihāragataṃ bhikkhuṃ, gaṅgātīre nisinnakaṃ, taṃ petī upasaṅkamma, dubbaṇṇā bhīrudassanā.

catutthe addasā'ti gaṅgātīre paññattavarabuddh'āsane nisinno addasa. vuyhamānan'ti caturassaṃ tacchetvā pabbat'antare ṭhapitaṃ vāt'ātapena suparisukkhaṃ pāvussake meghe vassante udakena uplavitvā anupubbena gaṅgāya nadiyā sote patitaṃ tena sotena vuyhamānaṃ.

24038.commentary: (DNa) gaṅg'odakaṃ yamun'odakenā'ti gaṅgāyamunānaṃ samāgamaṭṭhāne udakaṃ vaṇṇena'pi gandhena'pi rasena'pi saṃsandati sameti, majjhe bhinnasuvaṇṇaṃ viya ekasadisam'eva hoti, na mahāsamudda-udakena saṃsaṭṭhakāle viya visadisaṃ.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma gaṅg'odakaṃ yamun'odakena saṃsandati sameti, evam'eva supaññattā tena bhagavatā sāvakānaṃ nibbānagāminī paṭipadā, saṃsandati nibbānañ'ca paṭipadā ca.
taggha'si, tāta kumma, khato, taggha upahato. etena hi te, tāta kumma, suttakena pitaro ca pitāmahā ca anayaṃ āpannā byasanaṃ āpannā. gaccha dāni tvaṃ, tāta kumma, na dāni tvaṃ amhākan'ti.
hivibhatti lopam'āpajjate vā. gaccha, gacchāhi, gama, gamāhi, gamaya, gamayāhi. hī'ti kim'atthaṃ? gacchati, gamayati.

24043.meaning1: goes; walks; moves; wanders around; travels
24043.synonym: irīyati, kamati, carati, jaṅgamati, yāti, yāyati

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu gacchanto vā gacchāmī'ti pajānāti ṭhito vā ṭhito'mhī'ti pajānāti nisinno vā nisinno'mhī'ti pajānāti sayāno vā sayāno'mhī'ti pajānāti
yassa loke sakaṃ n'atthi, asatā ca na socati, dhammesu ca na gacchati, sa ve santo'ti vuccatī'ti.
tassa imissā ca asappāyakiriyāya, asuci visadoso apanīto saupādiseso tadubhayena vaṇo puthuttaṃ gaccheyya.
addasāma kho mayaṃ, bho, taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ gacchantaṃ, addasāma ṭhitaṃ, addasāma antaragharaṃ pavisantaṃ, addasāma antaraghare nisinnaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ
gacchanto kho pana ujumaggen'eva gacchati, tatr'āyaṃ ujumaggo, seyyath'idaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
ye'me pañca kāmaguṇā cetaso samphuṭṭhapubbā atītā niruddhā vipariṇatā, tatra me cittaṃ bahulaṃ gacchamānaṃ gaccheyya paccuppannesu vā appaṃ vā anāgatesu.

gamu'icc'etassa dhātussa anto makāro ccho hoti vā sabbāsu paccayavibhattīsu. gacchamāno, gacchanto. gacchati, gameti. gacchatu, gametu. gaccheyya. gameyya. agacchā, agamā. agacchī, agamī. gacchissati, gamissati. agacchissā, agamissā. gamisse'ti kim'atthaṃ? icchati.

24048.grammar: aor, reflx 1st sg of gacchi, trans (+acc)

examples.text: eso hi bhagavā buddho, nadiṃ nerañjaraṃ pati, sabbadukkhappahānāya, dhammaṃ deseti pāṇinaṃ, tass'āhaṃ santikaṃ gacchaṃ, so me satthā bhavissati.
gacch'āvuso, na me tayā saddhiṃ kathā vā nisajjā vā phāsu hoti, ekakassa me kathā vā nisajjā vā phāsu hotī'ti etadeva paccayaṃ karitvā anaññaṃ, pācittiyaṃ.
so tamhā'pi gāmā amuṃ gāmaṃ gacchiṃ, tatrā'pi evaṃ aṭṭhāsiṃ evaṃ nisīdiṃ evaṃ abhāsiṃ evaṃ tuṇhī ahosiṃ. so'mhi tamhā gāmā sakaṃ'y'eva gāmaṃ paccāgato'ti.

24051.meaning1: could go; would move; would walk
24051.commentary: (MNa) yaṃnūn'āhaṃ saṇikaṃ gaccheyyan'ti kiṃ me iminā sīghagamanena, saṇikaṃ gacchissāmī'ti cintesi.

examples.text: pathaviyā'pi ummujjanimujjaṃ kareyyaṃ, seyyathā'pi udake, udake'pi abhijjamāno gaccheyyaṃ, seyyathā'pi pathaviyaṃ, ākāse'pi pallaṅkena kameyyaṃ, seyyathā'pi pakkhī sakuṇo
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso sīghaṃ gaccheyya. tassa evam'assa, kiṃ nu kho ahaṃ sīghaṃ gacchāmi? yaṃnūn'āhaṃ saṇikaṃ gaccheyyan'ti. so saṇikaṃ gaccheyya.
tathā tu kassāmi yathā'pi issaro, yaṃ labbhati tena'pi hotu me alaṃ, vīriyena taṃ mayha vas'ānayissaṃ, gajaṃ'va mattaṃ kusal'aṅkusaggaho.

gajaṅgalā + ā

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā gajaṅgalāyaṃ viharati suveḷuvane. atha kho uttaro māṇavo pārāsiviy'antevāsī yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.

yathā balākayonimhi, na vijjati pumo sadā, meghesu gajjamānesu, gabbhaṃ gaṇhanti tā sadā.

24063.meaning1: roared; thundered; made a bold statement (by)

examples.text: gajjitaṃ kho tayā deva, micchā taṃ bahu gajjitaṃ, jānissāmi tuvaṃ ajja, sabbadhamme patiṭṭhitaṃ.
evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo gajjitā hoti, no vassitā. seyyathā'pi so, bhikkhave, valāhako gajjitā, no vassitā, tath'ūpam'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi.
gajjitā kālamegho'va, nīl'uppalasamasādiso, iddhibalena asamo, moggallāno mah'iddhiko.
mah'odadhiṃ aparimitaṃ mahāsaraṃ, bahubheravaṃ ratanagaṇānam'ālayaṃ, najjo yathā naragaṇasaṅghasevitā, puthū savantī upayanti sāgaraṃ.
atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassī bodhisatto aparena samayena eko gaṇamhā vūpakaṭṭho vihāsi, aññen'eva tāni caturāsīti pabbajitasahassāni agamaṃsu, aññena maggena vipassī bodhisatto.

sabbapaṭhamaṃ tāva kiñci'd'eva karuṇāyitabbarūpaṃ… hatthapādehi paggharantakimigaṇaṃ aṭṭassaraṃ karontaṃ disvā, kicchaṃ vat'āyaṃ satto āpanno, app'eva nāma imamhā dukkhā mucceyyā'ti karuṇā pavattetabbā.
pakudhako kātiyāno nigaṇṭho, ye c'āp'ime makkhalipūraṇāse, gaṇassa satthāro sāmaññappattā, na hi nūna te sappurisehi dūre'ti.
